question: In the methanol-to-oil sensitivity study, by how many percentage points does conversion rise from 20:1 to 30:1, and from 30:1 to 40:1?
rendered:
According to the document, at methanol-to-oil ratios (molar) of 20 : 1, 30 : 1, and 40 : 1, the conversion obtained from the results of the simulation is 93.5, 96.4, and 97.5, respectively. 

The rise in conversion from 20:1 to 30:1 is 96.4 - 93.5 = 2.9 percentage points.
The rise in conversion from 30:1 to 40:1 is 97.5 - 96.4 = 1.1 percentage points.
